items.title: Sherrie Maricle interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2020 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: moving to this new house with my partner, Susan

ctx.x: Have you taken up any non-musical initiatives to fill time?

Well yeah, I mean this year, in past year’s I’ve done this too but in recent years have not had time, so I planted a big herb garden and that kind of thing is fun, and did a little more landscaping, especially this new house I have, it’s a converted dairy barn from the 1800s in Westchester. It’s very cool. It’s not on a lot of acres or anything, it’s about two acres. But it’s very, very pretty. And I’m going to backtrack for a second because I moved March 25th and I was like, “Okay, it’s a pandemic, all the gigs…
I was going to ask which foot it was, and I can picture your appointment. “So Doc, when can I start playing the hi-hat.”
